supersedes: PR #212 ring+timeline tile — the owner chose the showcase 'timeline D' ConductorPage, which SUPERSEDES the PR-#212-era tile ACs.
note: Frozen acceptance manifest for the conductor showcase tile (web/src/pages/ConductorPage.tsx). Each 'delivered' AC names the REAL test node-id that would FAIL if the component regressed; 'retired'/'moved' ACs name a guard test that pins the retirement premise. A drift between this manifest and the named node-ids (a renamed/removed test, or a delivered AC with no proof) is itself a FAILURE — enforced by test_conductor_tile_acceptance_manifest.py. Do NOT re-point a proof to a comment or to a source-scan of an unrendered feature; add/retire an AC here instead.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The tile leads with a completion ring reading done SDLC steps / total (draining SVG arc, 'N' over 'of {total}', 'steps complete').
acceptance_criteria.note: Ring center + strokeDashoffset arc are the real rendered elements.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The tile's local SDLC_STEPS table matches the backend WORKFLOW_STEPS order exactly (no drift).
acceptance_criteria.note: De-launders the old 'WORKFLOW_STEPS_ORDERED in src' comment-scan: the tile duplicates a LOCAL table, so this cross-checks its ids against the backend.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The hero is the ring + a '{done}/{total} steps complete' summary sourced from live task data.
acceptance_criteria.note: The prototype's 2x2 metric grid (Current phase/Time left/Throughput/Idle) was superseded and is NOT rendered.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A labeled timeline renders a VISIBLE caption ({s.label}) and role ({s.role}) under each real SDLC step, mapping the real step table.
The abstract SdlcDots stepper is gone from the tile (replaced by the labeled timeline).
The status pill reads honest task.activity.state and maps the real states (working/awaiting_gate/adrift/stalled) to a label+tone via ACT_TILE.
The tile's throughput sparkline (TokenTurns) marks the window peak bar.
acceptance_criteria.note: The showcase tile renders no <TokenTurns>; a source-scan of TokenTurns.tsx proved nothing about the tile. Retired; guard asserts the tile stays TokenTurns-free.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The tile renders a task-card ETA UI (EtaCountdownBar + '~Xm left' chip) consuming eta_s/eta_total_s.
acceptance_criteria.note: The showcase tile never ported an ETA UI; a real task-card ETA remains OPEN + tracked on task 68a9720e and is NOT fake-satisfied. Backend ETA projection + SdlcProgress caption are delivered/proven by the runtime oracles in the same test file.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The tile's per-turn burn graph (TokenTurns) consumes tokens_source and labels the wall-clock 'project activity' case.
acceptance_criteria.note: The showcase tile renders no <TokenTurns>. tokens_source honesty is proven at runtime by the phase_progress oracles in test_conductor_token_source.py, not a source-scan of an unrendered component.
